in_hebrew.name: מַלְעָנָה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: A name derived from the Hebrew root 'ml', meaning 'to be soft, gentle, tender, merciful.' The name Malena can be interpreted as 'tender one' or 'compassionate one' in the biblical context.

in_greek.name: Μαλένα
in_greek.long_meaning: The Greek name Malena is derived from the Greek word 'malos', meaning 'graceful, soft, tender.' In the biblical context, the name Malena can be interpreted as 'gracious one' or 'compassionate one'.

in_latin.name: Malena
in_latin.long_meaning: The Latin name Malena is derived from the Latin word 'mollis', meaning 'gentle, tender, soft.' In the biblical context, the name Malena can be interpreted as 'gentle one' or 'compassionate one'.
